basis: one fixture, separate from per-module materials

items.description: Prewired 1000mm green AWG30 solid-wire receptacle; candidate only

Machined FR4 B-side carrier, 25 x 46 x 5 mm: 5 receptacle bores 0.98-1.00 mm, 3 datum pin holes 2.0 mm, 28 part through-cuts and 10 merge bridges, every wall at least 0.27 mm (INGUN-derived); geometry in carrier-study.step and manifest.json; fabricator not selected
Dowel pins 2.0 mm diameter, 1.0 mm above the carrier top (below the 1.6 mm board edge), press fit in the carrier: X1, X2 on the x = 16.2 board edge, Y1 on the y = 62.9 edge

F-side hold-down with 1.5 mm pressure pins at the three listed board points (over carrier land, clear of F courtyards by 0.3 mm), total clamp force above 6.35 N, plus a spring bias pushing the board against X1, X2 and Y1
Base under the carrier keeping free the receptacle tails and the J5 tail, probe guide, fixing to the carrier, insulation and wire retention for the 5 prewired receptacle leads

blockers: Hold-down/bias mechanism, datum pins, base, guide, fixing, insulation and wire retention are not selected or designed.
